summary: The dynamic multi-trainer referral system fully matches the approved design across both repos: no hardcoded dreamphysics branch/seed remains (only the reserved-word list, migration grandfather comment, and test fixtures), the server-side generator uses crypto.randomInt with an unambiguous alphabet and the repository transaction owns uniqueness via the shared claimability predicate, codes are normalized case-insensitively on connect, invalid/empty codes create no link, code changes deactivate the old index doc without touching trainerLinks, the one-active-trainer switch guard is confirm-driven with no silent overwrite and no counter write (verified by test asserting live counts A-1/B+1), role is set server-side from the verified token, referral endpoints stay behind authenticate+requireTrainer with trainers/referralCodes/trainerLinks fail-closed in firestore.rules, and the nutrition Add-Food fix is untouched. Both verification gates pass: backend typecheck+lint clean with 149 vitest tests, frontend analyze clean with 122 flutter tests.
